documents.title: Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Adopting Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
Board Meeting Intimation for Considering And Approving The Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Mangal Credit and Fincorp Limited announced its Q1FY22 financial performance, reporting a total AUM of Rs. 8,332 lacs and a net profit of Rs. 150.53 lacs. Management highlighted growth in client base, disbursals, and AUM despite challenges from the second wave of COVID-19. The company outlined forward-looking targets, including growing the topline by 40% by the end of FY22 and expanding its branch network.

guidance.claim: Management expects the topline to grow by 40% by the end of FY22.
guidance.quote: Management expects the topline to grow by 40% by end of FY22.

guidance.claim: The company targets a loan book of Rs. 11000 Lacs by the end of the current fiscal.
guidance.quote: It remains focused to increase their loan book/POS upto Rs. 50,000 lacs by 2025, targeting a loan book of Rs. 11000 Lacs by end of current fiscal.

guidance.claim: Management expects flagship Gold Loan Lending to grow by 150% in the current fiscal.
guidance.quote: Management remains committed to grow its flagship product ‘Gold Loan Lending’ and expects it to grow by 150% in current fiscal.

guidance.claim: MCFL is prudently aspiring to grow its loan book/POS upto 50,000 lacs by 2025, with a balanced product mix and expanding footprints in western and northern states of India.
guidance.quote: MCEL is prudently aspiring to grow its loan book/POS upto %50,000 lacs by 2025, with a balanced product mix and expanding footprints in western and northern states of India.

guidance.claim: MCFL focus will remain unchanged to expand its footprints in more than 10 new cities in which will translate into approx. 2000+ of new clients by the end of FY22.
guidance.quote: MCEFL focus will remain unchanged to expand its footprints in more than 10 new cities in which will translate into approx. 2000+ of new clients by the end of FY22.

demand_outlook.claim: Individuals and businesses sought loans for survival and business continuation due to challenging times from the second wave of COVID-19.
demand_outlook.quote: These challenging times have raised several concerns for viability of several businesses and families. This led to individuals and businesses seek loan for their survival and for continuing of their businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: The challenging times brought a great uptrend in the growth of the Gold/Diamond Loan business.
demand_outlook.quote: The current challenging times have brought a great uptrend in the growth of our Gold/Diamond Loan business and we have further moved a step ahead in our expansion plan by setting up yet another retail branch in order to gain more market share.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the gold and diamond jewellery loan industry is expected to grow at a CAGR of about 13.4 per cent over FY 2020-2022 to reach about INR 4,50,000 crore in FY 2022.
demand_outlook.quote: We are likely to ride the gold and diamond jewellery loan industry wave which is expected to grow at a CAGR of about 13.4 per cent over FY 2020-2022 to reach about INR 4,50,000 crore in FY 2022, with NBFCs leading the way.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong opportunities arising post Covid19 period in securitized based personal loans as small businesses and individuals require capital to restart operations.
demand_outlook.quote: We have strong plans and strategies to tap the growing opportunities arising post Covid19 period in securitized based personal loans, as large no. of small business and individuals would require capital to restart and resume operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its branch network into Gujarat and setting up yet another retail branch.
capex_expansion.quote: MICFL was established in 2012 and is a renowned NBFC based in Mumbai. It is expanding its branch network into Gujarat also.

capex_expansion.claim: Aggressive expansion plans aim to expand footprints through 10 more branches by the end of FY22.
capex_expansion.quote: These will be achieved by its aggressive expansion plans to expand its footprints through 10 more branches translating it to 1500+ clients by end of FY22.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced expansion plans of adding 5 more retail branches in areas of Mumbai and Thane.
capex_expansion.quote: the strong numbers have prompted us to come up with expansion plans of adding 5 more retail branches in areas of Mumbai and Thane with an aim to become a well-entrenched and dynamic players in this segment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened its first branch in Vile Parle, Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: We opened our first branch in Vile Parle, Mumbai and had fresh disbursements of Rs. 1957.15 lacs in just 9 months of operations.

margins_costs.quote: *Net Interest Income from operations recorded a growth by 29.79 % from 2% 816.53 lacs in FY20 to 2 1059.76 lacs in FY21 mainly driven by Unsecured & Jewellery loan product.

orders_capacity.quote: Our client base grew by 482% from 100 in Qi FY21 to 582 in Qi FY22 and disbursals grew by 210% from Rs. 431 lacs in Q1 FY21 to Rs. 1336 lacs in Q1 FY22.
